name: MNT-0003 Trace Projection Refresh

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/mnt-0003-trace-refresh-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/mnt-0003-trace-refresh.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout stable baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: 8a9deb9fbc5c49458605aa8e1a73e63947263ab8

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Refresh trace projection
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos verify >/tmp/eosv-refresh.txt
          grep 'EOSV RESULT: PASS' /tmp/eosv-refresh.txt
          git diff --name-only

      - name: Prove refresh determinism
        run: |
          first="$(sha256sum .eos/trace-edges.tsv | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          ./scripts/eos verify >/tmp/eosv-repeat.txt
          grep 'EOSV RESULT: PASS' /tmp/eosv-repeat.txt
          second="$(sha256sum .eos/trace-edges.tsv | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          test "$first" = "$second" || {
            echo "Trace projection remains unstable: $first -> $second" >&2
            exit 71
          }
          echo "trace projection deterministic: $second"

      - name: Enforce projection-only diff
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          changed = set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'], text=True).splitlines())
          if changed != {'.eos/trace-edges.tsv'}:
              raise SystemExit('unexpected trace refresh diff: ' + ', '.join(sorted(changed)))
          PY
          git diff --check -- .eos/trace-edges.tsv

      - name: Commit deterministic trace refresh
        run: |
          git add .eos/trace-edges.tsv
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "chore(eos): refresh deterministic trace projection"

      - name: Publish immutable trace refresh result
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/mnt-0003-trace-refresh-result-20260907
